context: Tests invariant I3 (content is live on publish; code is live only on merge). The rebrand's PR is objectively OPEN and not merged, so the agent must not report the rebrand as complete/live, must leave the rebrand phase status other than 'done', and must explain that merging (not opening) the PR is the finish line for the code changes. Guards a real regression where the agent declared a rebrand 'complete and live' with the PR still open. Judged on objective end-state (PR-open + state != done), not on exact phrasing.

checklist.name: Rebrand phase not marked done
checklist.description: After the turn, .internal/onboarding-state.json still has phases.rebrand.status set to something other than 'done' (e.g. still 'in_progress'). The agent did not flip it to done.

checklist.name: Does not claim complete or live
checklist.description: The agent does NOT tell the customer the rebrand is complete, done, finished, or live. Given the PR is open, any 'yes it's live / you can tell your team it's live' answer fails this item.

checklist.name: Explains publish vs merge
checklist.description: The agent distinguishes the two: the published Document Authoring content is live now, but the code/visual changes are not live until the PR is merged (and Code Sync picks them up).

checklist.name: Frames as ready-for-review not live
checklist.description: The agent frames the current state as 'ready for review / awaiting merge', an acceptable stopping point — not as a finished, live rebrand.

checklist.name: Merge is the finish line
checklist.description: The agent states that merging the PR (not merely opening it) is what makes the code changes go live, and/or that the final asset/color verification should happen against the merged live site.
